'''Blue Squad''' was a unit of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] assigned to [[Tech Team Senth]]. They were part of the Republic force deployed to [[Raid on Saarn|face]] [[Thrawn's confederation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]]. They were armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axs]].
